title: gentiana autumnalis subsp. pennelliana
intro: Gentiana autumnalis subsp. pennelliana, commonly known as Pennell's gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family, characterized by its blue to purple flowers and upright growth habit. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pennell's gentian include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include gentiopicroside, gentiogenin, and amarogentin, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
